description: Provinciaal Uitvoeringsprogramma Verkeer en Vervoer is a series of datasets listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NationaalGeoregister.nl. In het Provinciaal Uitvoeringsprogramma (PUP) verkeer en vervoer 2015 zijn de projecten, activiteiten en maatregelen en studies opgenomen die in 2015 voorbereid of uitgevoerd worden om de bereikbaarheid en verkeersveiligheid in Drenthe te verbeteren. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal lists 6 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher NationaalGeoregister.nl. Its tags are wegen. It offers 2 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/PNG, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/ZIP. The portal shows 2024-10-16 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
